name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
summary: At Grimtotem Post, Grundig Darkcloud waits after leading the force that sacked Makaba Flathoof's home. Makaba sends you after Grundig once you have struck down the ruffians and mercenaries.

sections.title: The Butcher of the Path
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof survived the Grimtotem assault on his settlement along the Stonetalon trail, but grief still weighs on him. You have proved yourself against Grimtotem foot soldiers. Now Makaba points you toward Grundig Darkcloud, who led the slaughter that leveled the village and commands a devoted band of brutes.

sections.title: Strike at Grimtotem Post
sections.body: Grundig camps at Grimtotem Post, farther up the mountain road to the west. You climb to the stronghold to avenge Makaba's kin and guard the pass from further violence. There you fight through Grundig's brutes and kill him before his raiders can descend on other vulnerable camps.

faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud commands the Grimtotem at Grimtotem Post in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains. He led the attack that destroyed Makaba Flathoof's village.

faq.q: Where can Grundig Darkcloud be found?
faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud is at Grimtotem Post, up the mountain trail west of Makaba Flathoof's camp near the Barrens border.

faq.q: What is Makaba Flathoof's motive for this task?
faq.answer: Makaba Flathoof saw the Grimtotem slaughter his home and clanmates. After you strike down their ruffians and mercenaries, he asks you to kill their leader, Grundig Darkcloud, in retribution.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem attacking peaceful settlements here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem despise other tauren tribes, especially those allied with the Horde or following gentler paths. They ambush and raid rival clans to drive them from lands the Grimtotem want to control.

faq.q: What comes after killing Grundig Darkcloud?
faq.answer: After you kill Grundig Darkcloud and his brutes, Makaba Flathoof's vengeance is complete. He can mourn his village knowing justice has been served.

faq.q: What is the prerequisite quest for this task?
faq.answer: First, complete Avenge My Village. There, Makaba Flathoof tests your resolve by sending you against Grimtotem ruffians and mercenaries camped just to the west.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see Grundig's slaughter deepen the discord among your people. The Grimtotem oppose unity under the Horde with cutthroat force.
As a member of the Horde, you know Stonetalon matters to your advance into Kalimdor. Warlords like Grundig threaten the supply routes between the Barrens and Sun Rock Retreat.
